active_goal.objective: Ship a production-ready Sfora learned-vector-space retrieval library whose deployed image-to-top-k system surpasses the strongest protocol-matched published quality reference on BOTH SOP and DeepFashion In-Shop and is faster end-to-end at matched quality, hardware, cache, batch size and gallery scale. Preserve all current Sfora work, consultations and DGX jobs, inspect before launching, and do not duplicate. Current verified exploratory anchors: three-seed public-config SOP official TEST packed R@1 91.7419% versus dated UNICOM 91.2%, but TEST was previously observed and no matched full-pipeline speed win exists; older three-seed In-Shop official query/gallery packed R@1 95.4823% versus UNICOM 96.7%, while the newer true-freeze checkpoint has no official result. Its TRAIN holdout diagnostic got 97.6235% on 6,354 queries, but this is not an official or scale-projected result; impostor-count misses are sublinear, so the linear scaling premise failed. Preserve actual packed-score quality; exact output parity is mandatory for kernel changes. Measure training time, images/s and VRAM and full decode/preprocess/encoder/packing/native-search/image-to-top-k p50/p95/p99 and QPS at batch1 and batch32, same hardware and query/gallery. Use Opus 5.5 plus GPT-6 Astra for consequential critique and Fable for truly new research, without duplicate jobs. - Combined authority passes `H + S` through the real adapted evaluator → fitter → quadratic exit chain.
- Unknown additions fail even when their correct hashes appear in ordinary guards.
- Missing mappings, forged module origins, conflicting membership, changed binary/build evidence, and same-size/restored-mtime mutations fail.
- A mutation introduced before the nested/final audit is detected there.
- Original source-subset, exact-four, FIT/TRAIN, closure, bundle, live-function, and ownership failures still reject.
- Existing modules/globals remain unchanged; the original candidate-GO-only driver continues rejecting KILL.
